item_short_desc: Rothco's General Purpose Utility Straps are crafted from durable heavyweight material designed to hold the weight of most tactical bags. These versatile straps can turn any of your bags into an easy-to-carry shoulder bag with ease. The metal spring hooks provide secure attachment to duffle bags, pouches, and packs equipped with eyelet systems. Available in 2 sizes, 48 inches and 55 inches, these straps are perfect for a variety of uses, including carrying larger items like our Giant Duffle Bags.
description: Rothco's General Purpose Utility Straps are crafted from durable heavyweight material designed to hold the weight of most tactical bags. These versatile straps can turn any of your bags into an easy-to-carry shoulder bag with ease. The metal spring hooks provide secure attachment to duffle bags, pouches, and packs equipped with eyelet systems. Whether you're heading to the gym, going on a trip, or need an extra strap for your gear, Rothco's General Purpose Utility Straps are the ideal solution for convenient and reliable carrying.
